answer: Each identity must post a bond of locked capital slashed on defection, so cloning yourself across many wallets clones the cost too. Payouts come from escrow per verified job, never per account, so a puppet with no work earns nothing. Attestations carry a nonce and signature, and accounts vouching only for each other get down-weighted, turning a whisper net of fakes into an isolatable cluster. A cedar of long-lived reputation must be regrown from zero after every burn, so sustained Sybil activity costs more per epoch than honest work, pricing the swarm out at a clear nadir.
